name: Season 1
overview: A missing child sets four families on a frantic hunt for answers as they unearth a mind-bending mystery that spans three generations.

episodes.name: Secrets
episodes.overview: In 2019, a local boy's disappearance stokes fear in the residents of Winden, a small German town with a strange and tragic history.

episodes.name: Lies
episodes.overview: When a grim discovery leaves the police baffled, Ulrich seeks a search warrant for the power plant. A mysterious stranger checks into the hotel.

episodes.name: Past and Present
episodes.overview: It's 1986, and Ulrich's brother, Mads, has been missing for a month. Confusion reigns as past and present intertwine.

episodes.name: Double Lives
episodes.overview: Bizarre occurrences give Charlotte a sense of déjà vu, and she suspects Peter is hiding something. Franziska snaps when Magnus confronts her.

episodes.name: Truths
episodes.overview: Hannah takes her obsession with Ulrich too far. The stranger asks Regina to deliver an important package. Martha is torn between Jonas and Bartosz.

episodes.name: Sic Mundus Creatus Est
episodes.overview: Ulrich looks to the past for answers and dredges up disturbing family secrets. Armed with new tools, Jonas probes the cave's murky depths.

episodes.name: Crossroads
episodes.overview: Ulrich questions a frail and frightened Helge in the nursing home. Jonas searches for Mikkel, but the stranger warns him about meddling with the past.

episodes.name: As You Sow, So You Shall Reap
episodes.overview: In 1953, the disfigured bodies of two boys are exhumed at a construction site, the future location of Winden's nuclear power plant.

episodes.name: Everything Is Now
episodes.overview: Ulrich runs afoul of the law, Helge tries to dodge Egon Tiedemann, Claudia harnesses the cave's powers, and Katharina lashes out at Hannah.

episodes.name: Alpha and Omega
episodes.overview: Peter gets a shock. Jonas learns the truth about his family, but there are more surprises still to come. Helge makes a sacrifice.
